items.reason: Requirement boundaries still changed in the final configured audit round.

The source confirms that Thrive is used on the current site and absent from the replacement site, but it does not resolve whether the vulnerable installation should be updated, retained temporarily, or removed; propagation requires a further remediation decision.

unresolved_candidate.description: Harborline contact-form email delivery is identified as a behavior that should remain functional after remediation, but the supplied history contains only freelancer requests to test it and no clear client confirmation or observed result.

Full removal of the Thrive page builder and migration of remaining pages to Elementor are discussed conditionally. The evidence supports interim vulnerable-plugin handling but does not clearly establish a committed standalone migration Requirement.

Stonefield contact-form functionality and administrator password rotation are requested as follow-up checks, but no client acceptance or completion evidence establishes whether either should be a separate Requirement.
